methodology.population: 100 curated module targets + 626 additional existing non-test/non-fixture source modules + 274 source-declared functions nested within modules
methodology.exclusions: tests, fixtures, UI-preview, UI assets, public assets, build output and generated names matched by documented filters; path-level census, not full semantic source audit
methodology.heuristic: Filename/path heuristics and original curated scores; rankings, CPU/RAM, cadence, native fit are hypotheses not measured loads; declared function presence does not demonstrate purity or runtime use

confidence_levels.TRACKED_PATH: Git tree confirms file exists only; not demonstrated separate algorithm
confidence_levels.DECLARATION: named function declaration found via anchored regexp in actual source; body/runtime not audited

methodology.frequency: ALWAYS_ON only for proven continuous runtime activity (none proven); HIGH_FREQUENCY active hot path; FREQUENT event-driven; USER_DEFINED high/medium/low behavior; MEDIUM_FREQUENCY periodic; LOW_FREQUENCY rare; DEV_ADMIN dev/admin high/medium/low
methodology.boundaries: Host authority/consent/ledger and browser sender, UI publication and provider transport stay in current owner. Reuse native HQKG/programmability; no duplicate graph/store/scheduler/effect owner.
methodology.other: No actual donor migration comparison or benchmarks executed; Rust port decisions require source/caller and profiler validation
